sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Even though the fall into the sparks of negative commandments involves things bound by the forces of impurity, they still have a tangible existence that allows for service, unlike trials which involve things with no true existence.

translations.translation: Now, even though the fall into the sparks that are in the negative commandments is in matters that are forbidden and bound in the hands of the external forces,
nevertheless, they have existence,
therefore the concept of service applies to them,
at least through negation and rejection,
as explained above.
And therefore, also the light drawn down through negative commandments,
even though it is a surrounding light,
the aspect of Yud-Hei of the Name Havayah,
nevertheless, the Yud-Hei of the Name Havayah are also letters of the Name Havayah,
for letters are matters of revelation
(except that in the letters themselves there is a difference between Vav-Hei of the Name Havayah, which is analogous to internal light,
and Yud-Hei of the Name Havayah, which is analogous to surrounding light).
However, trials are different,
they are in things that have no existence.
For, although the matters in which the fulfillment of negative commandments occurs are matters of kelipah,
nevertheless,
there is no necessity to say that this is their entire existence in opposition to holiness.
And the proof is that there are several matters that are forbidden only for eating but permitted for benefit
(for through this it is possible to elevate them to holiness),
and even to the extent that some are obligatory for their benefit.
And similarly, there are many levels and distinctions in forbidden matters that are not opposed to the will of G-d in all their aspects and in all their details.
And furthermore,
sometimes even the forbidden thing itself becomes permitted,
like the saying of our Rabbis, of blessed memory,
that at the time of the conquest of the land
(and similarly in a war analogous to it)
the pork rinds were also permitted to them,
which became blood and flesh like his own flesh,
and with this power the conquest of the land was accomplished
(therefore it was permitted to them,
as explained in the books of the simple commentators),
meaning that it assists holiness.
However, with trials it is different,
their existence is that a thing was placed to conceal and prevent the service of G-d,
and were it not for this, it has no existence,
even not in a manner of imagination.
And since the fall is to the very lowest level,
in matters whose entire existence is only in opposition to the will of G-d,
it is therefore understood,
that their source is from a more elevated place.
And therefore, through the service of trials,
where the descent is to the very lowest,
through this a person is elevated to an ascent higher and higher.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: The superiority of the service of trials over positive and negative commandments lies not only in the root of their sparks but also in the greater human effort required, culminating in self-sacrifice that nullifies the trial entirely.

translations.translation: Now, all matters of holiness are drawn down specifically through service
(and not in a manner of "bread of shame"),
from which it is understood,
that the superiority of the service of trials over the service of positive and negative commandments is not only from the aspect of the root of the sparks in them,
but also from the aspect of the effort and service of the person in this service.
For just as the service and effort in fulfilling positive commandments is not comparable to the service in negative commandments,
since to avoid transgressing a negative commandment one must make fences, etc.,
and "sanctify yourself with what is permitted to you,"
similarly, the effort in fulfilling negative commandments is not comparable to the strength, force, and courage required in the service of trials.
And it can be said that this is the meaning of our Rabbis' statement, of blessed memory,
regarding the trial of the Binding,
that this is the first trial explicitly mentioned in Scripture,
"And G-d tested Avraham,"

that the Holy One, blessed be He, said to Avraham: "I have tested you with several trials and you withstood them all; now stand for Me in this trial, lest they say there is no substance in the first ones."
That is,
for in the first nine trials there was not yet the perfection of the service and effort of trials,
therefore they were not explicitly mentioned in the Written Torah,
for in writing and revelation, this is not yet the perfection of the concept of trial.
And through his withstanding this trial, it completes and validates all of Avraham's service
(even his service beforehand).
This is because of "Koshet Selah," and the Targum Yonatan explains: "Because of Avraham's truth forever,"
which is the truth that was revealed through Avraham's service.
And this is what is explained in the maamar,
that to withstand a trial, the service according to the Tree of Knowledge is insufficient,
and even service according to the Tree of Knowledge that is founded on self-sacrifice,
rather, the service must be one whose entire essence is self-sacrifice.
And the concept is,
that since engagement in trials is in a matter that has no existence,
and its existence is only that a thing was placed to conceal and prevent, as above,
therefore, the manner of its refinement is not through service that gives existence and a place of grasp to the thing being refined,
but rather through service that nullifies it completely.
For in service according to the Tree of Knowledge,
even the holy Tree of Knowledge of the Divine soul,
since it is connected with give-and-take and reasoning in the intellect,
this itself indicates that there is an opposing existence with which one fights,
therefore this service will not suffice for trials, through which is the refinement of matters that have no existence.
Rather, it is through self-sacrifice with great strength,
that does not enter into any give-and-take or calculation,
and nullifies the trial completely, as if there is no existence that needs to be fought, etc.
Therefore, this service is
(in the encompassing aspects of the soul itself)
from the aspect of the Yechidah in the soul, as above,
for specifically from this aspect there is no place for any existence other than holiness,
and the other matters are mere imagination,
and even the existence of the imagination is only for the sake of holiness,
so that through it a person may be elevated to a greater ascent,
which is above even the ascent accomplished through the service of positive and negative commandments,
until it is even above the service
(in matters of negative commandments)
of "intentional sins become for him like merits,"
which is the service of repentance,
and repentance from love, sins become like merits in general.

sections.sectionSummaryBrief: Trials themselves have many levels, with the greatest concealment occurring in the latter generations, especially the heels of Moshiach, requiring immense self-sacrifice and strength to overcome.

translations.translation: A)
Now, even in trials themselves there are several levels.
For just as in the matter of miracles there are several levels, one above the other
(miracle,
miracle within a miracle, etc.),
similarly, in trials there are several levels, one below the other,
and as explained by the Tzemach Tzedek in the discourse "Acharei Hashem Elokeichem"
(printed at the end of his Sefer HaMitzvos)
several levels in this.
And in general it is,
as brought by the Rebbe
(the Rebbe Rashab)
of blessed memory, in his maamar "Nasata Lire'echa Nes LeHisnoses"
the statement of the Midrash:
"Come and see the difference between the early ones and the later ones,
that the early ones were tested by the Holy One, blessed be He, as it says 'And G-d tested Avraham,' etc., but the later ones were tested by the nations of the world, etc."
For in the trials that come through the nations of the world, the concealment and hiding is greater than in ordinary trials.
Therefore, to withstand these trials requires a more elevated level in self-nullification and self-sacrifice itself.
And it can be said that this is why the main matter of trials is specifically in the latter generations,
and primarily in the generation of the heels of Moshiach,
when the darkness is double and redoubled,
and the service is with self-sacrifice.
And as explained in the maamarim of our Nesi'im,
and especially in the maamarim of the Baal HaGeulah VeHaSimchah,
on the explanation of the verse:
"And the man Moshe was very humble, more than any person on the face of the earth,"
that primarily this was because of the generation of the heels of Moshiach,
when the concealments and hiding places are great,
and nevertheless they stand with immense strength and learn Torah and fulfill mitzvos with self-sacrifice,
behold, because of this
(in the language of the maamar)
Moshe Rabbeinu fell into a state of "Aych zich arop gefalin."
And similarly to the situation as it was at the time of the imprisonment in that country, etc.
And likewise also now,
even though there are not such confusions and hindrances, G-d forbid, on the fulfillment of Torah and mitzvos,
nevertheless, there are trials from the side of expansion and wealth,
for sometimes from the side of expansion, etc., the trial is very great.
For the evil inclination is an expert in its craft,
"today it says to him: do this," etc.,
and it confuses a person from the service of G-d, so that at least it will not be in perfect completeness,
like one who intends to do [good].
And through this it brings a person down from level to level, etc.,
first in matters of the overcoming
of the animal soul from nogah, and then in matters of inadvertent sin, and then, etc.
And to withstand all these trials, a person must serve his service with great strength,
and in the language of the Tanya:
"He shall thunder upon her with a voice of noise," etc., as our Rabbis said:
"A person should always incite the good inclination against the evil inclination," etc.,
through which he nullifies all its existence,
and on the contrary,
it becomes an assistant, "for even his enemies make peace with him," this is the serpent.
And from this very fact that the service of the heels of Moshiach is most difficult,
this itself is proof that the powers for this exist and are given,
"I do not ask according to My power, but according to their power,"
meaning that the power is given to each one to arouse the strength from the aspect of the essence of the soul,
and in such a manner that it shines also in his internal powers,
even to his thought, speech, and action,
so that through this they are all surrendered to G-d, to His Torah, and to His mitzvos.
